Cars on the internal roads, including the white car near the entrance and dark cars along the main internal road, move slowly and smoothly along their lanes at a calm, realistic pace. The lake surface stays calm with a subtle golden shimmer and only slight ripple movement, and the forest canopy and community greenery sway very subtly in a light breeze. The soft golden-hour glow holds throughout with no change in time of day, and nothing new enters the scene abruptly.

overall_soundscape: A quiet, distant ambient bed of light wind over water, with faint, soft wingbeats from the passing birds and the barely audible hum of slow-moving cars far below. Gentle water lapping and subtle rustling of leaves continue underneath.
